title: CF Meet Messaging common v1
description: Messaging vocabulary and messages (Part V Workstreams C–D): error envelope, security profiles, protocol / cipher suite, devices and their PUBLIC MLS material, registration challenges, KeyPackage publication, the key-transparency tree head and proofs, conversations, context classes, lifecycle, policies. Never a private key, group secret, ciphertext or plaintext content. 1.16.0: conversation retentionSeconds / expiryGraceSeconds, pin expiry (PinRequest), ThreadSummary. 1.17.0: usage types REALTIME_CONNECTION (SECONDS), ATTACHMENT_EGRESS (BYTES), SEARCH_QUERY (QUERIES). 1.18.0: successor conversations (predecessorConversationId / successorConversationId, profileChangeDisclosureAcknowledged). 1.19.0: member roles MODERATOR / READ_ONLY / BOT_SERVICE, invitations (INVITED state, InvitationList), member authoritySource. 1.20.0: read receipts per conversation (readReceipts) and per user (shareReadReceipts); DIRECT message requests (requestsRequireAcceptance). 1.25.0: PushConfiguration (push platforms of the deployment and the Web Push application-server key). 1.26.0: PolicyView.applicationBaseline (CF Meet chat M1). 1.27.0: Readiness.routingProtocol (optional; routing fence protocol v1 of the Notification Service cutover). 1.28.0: ClientTokenRequest.accountSessionRef (first-party relays bind a client token to one account session; gap audit A11). 1.31.0 (CF Meet Platform Build, ADR 0062 / 0063): PolicyView.applicationBaseline CFMEET_PLATFORM_PARTNER (EXTERNAL environments while partner session devices are enabled: every context allows MANAGED and PRIVATE_E2EE with MANAGED the default, attachments on); UserSessionRequest / UserSession (the user-token exchange for a MANAGED-only partner session device); UserPushRegistrationRequest / UserPushRegistration (partner push registrations synchronised to the Notification Service). 1.31.0 (CF Meet Apps, ADR 0064): Message.viaApplicationId — the CF Meet App whose OAuth credential sent the message (present only on such messages, so clients can label "sent by App X"). 1.33.0: CommitRequest.groupInfo; MlsGroupState.groupInfo / groupInfoEpoch (MLS self-join by external commit); Device.keyPackagesAvailable (own devices only); KeyPackageClaimRequest.deviceIds. 1.34.0: chat controls — ConversationInbox.archived / pinned / pinnedAt and ConversationInboxSettings(Request) (F1), SendMessageRequest.mentionedPrincipalIds for PRIVATE_E2EE (B3), UpdateConversationRequest.retentionSeconds may lengthen or turn off disappearing messages (B4). 1.35.0: Readiness.sendPolicyProtocol / sendPolicyGeneration / sendPolicyLocalEnabled report the synchronous block-projection rollout (optional for older replicas). 1.36.0: chat organization and polls — ConversationInbox.favourite and ConversationInboxSettings(Request).favourite (WhatsApp Favourites); ChatList / ChatListPage / CreateChatListRequest / UpdateChatListRequest / ChatListDeleted (the member's own chat lists); SendMessageRequest.poll / PollRequest, Message.managed.presentation POLL and Message.managed.poll / Poll / PollOption, PollVoteRequest, PollChangeResult (MANAGED polls); ConversationLastMessage.presentation / attachmentKind (chat list icons); Conversation / CreateConversationRequest / UpdateConversationRequest.description (MANAGED group description); avatarRef attachment:<attachmentId> (group photo). 1.37.0 (ADR 0069): Status, status audiences, social media and Channels schemas.

Error.description: Error envelope. Messages never contain key material, ciphertext, content, a credential or database text.

SecurityProfile.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: client-side MLS 1.0 encryption, the server holds no decryption key. MANAGED: server-processable, never presented as E2EE.

registrationBinding.description: The exact RFC 9420 application_id leaf extension the registration KeyPackage must carry.

credentialIdentity.description: The exact BasicCredential identity of every KeyPackage of the device.

RegistrationChallenge.description: A single-use registration challenge with a server-assigned device id.

keyPackage.description: base64url of the registration KeyPackage (RFC 9420 MLSMessage, wire format mls_key_package).

signaturePublicKey.description: base64url Ed25519 MLS signature PUBLIC key (32 bytes).

keyPackagesAvailable.description: Published, unexpired, unclaimed KeyPackages of this device. Only in the acting principal's view of its OWN devices, so each device keeps a stock that others can add it from while it is offline.

Device.description: A Messaging device: PUBLIC key material only (never a private key).

logId.description: The deployment's key-transparency log (stable across key rotation); signed.

timestamp.description: When this head was produced (RFC 3339, microseconds).

timestampMicros.description: The same instant in Unix microseconds: exactly what the signature covers.

keyId.description: First 8 bytes (hex) of SHA-256 of the log's Ed25519 public key, which clients pin out of band.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over the length-prefixed encoding of label 'cfmeet-messaging-kt-tree-head:v1', logId, treeSize (u64 BE), rootHash and timestampMicros (i64 BE) — packages/messaging-crypto transparency::tree_head_signing_input / verify_tree_head_signature (Part V G.5).

witnessStatus.description: WITNESSED only when at least witnessQuorum distinct configured witnesses cosigned exactly this head (verify with packages/messaging-crypto transparency::verify_witnessed_tree_head against witness keys you pin). UNWITNESSED: verifiable but not, by itself, anti-equivocation.

witnessQuorum.description: Distinct witness cosignatures this deployment requires for WITNESSED (0: no witnesses configured).

cosignatures.description: Witness cosignatures of exactly this head (logId, treeSize, rootHash, timestampMicros), each already verified by Messaging under the witness's pinned key; clients verify them again.

TreeHead.description: A SIGNED tree head (Part V G.5) with the cosignatures of independent key-transparency witnesses (AD-05). The log signing key is a server secret distinct from the service-authentication key. A witness cosigns a head only after verifying the log signature and a consistency proof from the last head it cosigned, so a quorum of witnesses prevents the log from showing different views.

leafData.description: base64url of the exact leaf bytes the log hashed (canonical JSON).

routingProtocol.description: Routing fence protocol of the Notification Service cutover (Document 4 §9) this replica implements; present only once its migration history is applied. Absent from pre-fence binaries.

sendPolicyProtocol.description: Block projection protocol, or null before its additive migration is ready.

sendPolicyGeneration.description: Rollout generation shared with synchronous block producers, or null when unprepared.

sendPolicyLocalEnabled.description: Whether direct sends use the prepared local block projection.

ContextClass.description: Generic context classes; a product's order, trip, consultation or case is only an opaque ContextRef.

ContextRef.description: An opaque reference in the application's own namespace. Never authority, never a membership grant.

managedDisclosureAcknowledged.description: Regulated contexts: creating a MANAGED conversation requires acknowledging that the server can read its content (refused otherwise with MANAGED_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED).

expiryGraceSeconds.description: §38: requires an expiring conversation. Past expiresAt the conversation refuses new messages (CONVERSATION_NOT_ACTIVE / EXPIRED) but stays readable and extendable for this many seconds before it becomes EXPIRED.

retentionSeconds.description: §90 / disappearing messages: a conversation-specific retention, never looser than the context's (or environment's) retention policy (RETENTION_LOOSER_THAN_POLICY). The retention worker expires older messages (tombstone, then purge unless a legal hold protects them); clients delete locally on the same timer. Audited.

predecessorConversationId.description: Appendix G: create a deliberate SUCCESSOR of this conversation (the only way to move to another security profile). The caller must be an ACTIVE OWNER / ADMIN of it; same context class (DIRECT: the same two principals); never a context-bound conversation (SUCCESSOR_CONTEXT_BOUND); one successor each (SUCCESSOR_EXISTS). No content and no members are copied.

profileChangeDisclosureAcknowledged.description: Required (true) when the successor's security profile differs from its predecessor's; refused otherwise with SECURITY_PROFILE_NOT_ALLOWED / PROFILE_CHANGE_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED. Clients show the change (e.g. end-to-end encrypted to server-readable) before acknowledging.

readReceipts.description: Appendix K: false turns read receipts off for this conversation (never on where the environment policy has them off).

counterpartCfMeetId.description: Personal CF Meet ID resolved privately through Communications under the authenticated actor and scope. Exactly one recipient identifier is allowed. Rotation invalidates the old public ID; existing canonical conversations remain unchanged.

title.description: Section 13: display title (MANAGED only; PRIVATE_E2EE refuses it with CONTENT_REJECTED / DISPLAY_METADATA_MANAGED_ONLY).

description.description: 1.36.0: a group description (MANAGED, non-DIRECT only; trimmed; line breaks allowed, no other control characters).

CreateConversationRequest.description: A tenant / application / environment is never part of a request: it comes from the authenticated credential.

members.description: The first 100 ACTIVE members (owner, administrators, then members); page through GET /v1/conversations/{id}/members for the rest (membersTruncated).

readReceipts.description: Appendix K: false — no read receipts in this conversation; null — the environment policy decides.

title.description: Section 13: display title of a MANAGED conversation (always null for PRIVATE_E2EE, whose name belongs inside the MLS group).

avatarRef.description: Section 13: opaque avatar reference of a MANAGED conversation (for example an attachment id the client resolves); never a URL the server fetches. 1.36.0: attachment:<attachmentId> is a group photo attachment of the conversation.

announcementOnly.description: S13: only OWNER / ADMIN members may send (send, edit and forward); others read and react as policy allows.

description.description: 1.36.0: a MANAGED group's description (always null for DIRECT and PRIVATE_E2EE conversations, whose metadata belongs inside the MLS group).

Conversation.description: The canonical Conversation aggregate. PRIVATE_E2EE: MLS 1.0 with the server-assigned 32-byte MLS group id; serverCanReadContent is false. MANAGED: no MLS binding; serverCanReadContent is true.

oneOf.description: Opaque; valid only with the same orderBy.

retentionSeconds.description: §90 / disappearing messages: a conversation-specific retention, never looser than the context's (or environment's) retention policy (RETENTION_LOOSER_THAN_POLICY). The retention worker expires older messages (tombstone, then purge unless a legal hold protects them); clients delete locally on the same timer. Audited. B4 (1.34.0): it can be shortened, lengthened or turned off (null) within that limit — by the owner, a group's ADMIN or either member of a DIRECT conversation (another member: 403 PRINCIPAL_NOT_AUTHORIZED / NOT_ADMIN); each message keeps the retention in force when it was sent, so a change applies to messages sent after it.

title.description: Section 13: a new display title; null clears it (MANAGED only, owner).

avatarRef.description: Section 13: a new avatar reference; null clears it (MANAGED only). 1.36.0: attachment:<attachmentId> names a READY image attachment uploaded to this conversation (the group photo; members read it through the attachment download / thumbnail grants, and it is not removed as an abandoned upload while it is the avatar). Title, avatarRef and description alone may be changed by the owner or a group admin.

announcementOnly.description: S13 (owner): announcement-only on / off; GROUP and CHANNEL only.

description.description: 1.36.0: a new group description; null clears it (MANAGED, non-DIRECT; the owner or a group admin).

UpdateConversationRequest.description: Optimistic concurrency on the aggregate version. EXPIRED is set by the server only. A security profile can never be changed (SECURITY_PROFILE_IMMUTABLE).

centralArchiveRequired.description: Only MANAGED is allowed (allowedProfiles must be [MANAGED]); an E2EE conversation can never be archived by the server.

exportsEnabled.description: Requires MANAGED; the server never exports E2EE plaintext.

smsBridgeEligible.description: Requires MANAGED among allowedProfiles; SMS is never end-to-end encrypted.

requestsRequireAcceptance.description: Appendix K (DIRECT only): a new direct conversation is a message request — the counterpart is INVITED (no delivery, events or key packages) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept), then sees the conversation from the start. While pending, PRIVATE_E2EE requests carry no messages (REQUEST_PENDING); after a decline nothing more is delivered (DELIVERY_REFUSED / REQUEST_DECLINED).

forwarding.description: S11: server-side forwarding of MANAGED messages (default true).

forwardShowsOriginalSender.description: S11: forwarded copies show their original sender (default false).

ApplicationPolicy.description: An application environment's overrides of the platform defaults. MANAGED is available for a context only when listed here.

smsBridgeEligible.description: A MANAGED conversation of this context may be bridged to SMS (default: whenever MANAGED is allowed; never for an E2EE-only context).

requestsRequireAcceptance.description: Appendix K (DIRECT only): a new direct conversation is a message request — the counterpart is INVITED (no delivery, events or key packages) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept), then sees the conversation from the start. While pending, PRIVATE_E2EE requests carry no messages (REQUEST_PENDING); after a decline nothing more is delivered (DELIVERY_REFUSED / REQUEST_DECLINED).

messages.description: Message features (platform policy version 4). Replies are always supported; a tenant may turn threads off (replies are kept without a thread root), reactions or pins.

forwarding.description: S11: server-side forwarding of MANAGED messages (default true).

forwardShowsOriginalSender.description: S11: forwarded copies show their original sender (default false).

deliveryReceipts.description: Other members learn when a message was DELIVERED to a recipient (messaging.delivery-cursor.updated / delivery-cursor.updated events).

revisionHistoryVisible.description: Members may read the kept revisions of edited MANAGED messages. Revisions are always kept (exports and legal holds include them).

EffectivePolicy.description: Platform defaults merged with the application's overrides (deterministic; stored as an immutable content-addressed snapshot). Platform policy version 3 (Parts E-G): attachments (off by default), editing windows, privacy of presence / typing / read receipts, retention, moderation, abuse limits; regulated context controls.

deployment.description: What THIS deployment can run (1.23.0): PRIVATE_E2EE needs E2EE devices, MANAGED the managed key ring. usableProfiles lists, per enabled context, the allowed profiles that are actually available; contextsWithoutUsableProfile names enabled contexts in which no conversation can currently be created. A policy update that would leave a context it configures without a usable profile is refused (VALIDATION_ERROR). 1.24.0: e2eeProductionRelease is the owner's production release decision for personal E2EE (decision id, date, the ACTUAL independent-assessment status and the accepted residual risks); null outside production or while E2EE devices are disabled. It is never a certification claim.

applicationBaseline.description: 1.26.0 (CF Meet chat M1): the named, code-defined baseline layered between the platform defaults and this environment's application policy (effective = platform defaults <- baseline <- policy; an explicit policy setting always wins). CFMEET_FIRST_PARTY (CF Meet's own personal application environment only): attachments enabled, maxBytes 26214400, allowedKinds IMAGE / DOCUMENT / FILE / VOICE_NOTE / VIDEO. null for every other environment. `policy` stays the application's own document. 1.31.0: CFMEET_PLATFORM_PARTNER (ADR 0062) for EXTERNAL environments while MESSAGING_PARTNER_SESSION_DEVICES_ENABLED is on: every context class allows [MANAGED, PRIVATE_E2EE] with MANAGED as the default, attachments enabled; an explicit application setting still wins.

MemberRole.description: §30: OWNER (the owner), ADMIN, MODERATOR (moderates MEMBER / READ_ONLY / BOT_SERVICE members: remove, ban, unban; no role or ownership administration), MEMBER, READ_ONLY (reads its history window, sends no messages: READ_ONLY_MEMBER), BOT_SERVICE (BOT_OR_SERVICE principals only).

MessageLifecycle.description: ACTIVE carries content; every other state is a tombstone without content. HIDDEN_FOR_YOU: deleted on the reader's own devices only.

authoritySource.description: How the membership came to be: an administrator or the application backend (API), an accepted invitation, the meeting integration, an invite link (INVITE_LINK) or an organization team snapshot (ORGANIZATION_TEAM, G7).

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

role.description: BOT_SERVICE only for BOT_OR_SERVICE principals (BOT_SERVICE_REQUIRES_BOT_PRINCIPAL); bots are never ADMIN / MODERATOR (BOT_CANNOT_ADMINISTER).

invite.description: §35: invite instead of adding. The principal becomes INVITED (no history, no events, no sends) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept); invitations expire after 7 days and count toward the member limit.

cfMeetId.description: Personal CF Meet ID resolved privately through Communications under the authenticated actor and scope. Exactly one recipient identifier is allowed. Rotation invalidates the old public ID; existing canonical conversations remain unchanged.

cryptographicRemoval.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the server-side removal is authorization only; a member's MLS commit removing the devices completes the cryptographic exclusion.

ciphertext.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the MLS PrivateMessage (MLSMessage bytes, base64url). Never plaintext.

text.description: MANAGED plain text (UTF-8, 1-16384 characters, no control characters). No markup subset is defined: the server never interprets HTML, Markdown or scripts, stores the text exactly as given and returns it as a JSON string; clients render it as text (escaping it), never as markup.

notify.description: false: no push notification jobs (mirrored / migrated writes). Default true.

managedPresentation.description: MANAGED only (refused for PRIVATE_E2EE, whose presentation travels inside the ciphertext).

mentionedPrincipalIds.description: Section 13: current ACTIVE members this message mentions (ids only; the sender is ignored; anyone else is VALIDATION_ERROR). Used only for the members' mention count and the "mentions only" notification preference. B3 (1.34.0): PRIVATE_E2EE accepts it too — only these ids reach the server, the mention text stays inside the ciphertext; not on an EDIT. A retry with the same clientMessageId must repeat the text and the attachment set (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED otherwise) and is answered before rate limits are charged.

frankingCommitment.description: S2, PRIVATE_E2EE only (optional): hex(HMAC-SHA256(frankingKey, 'cfmeet-messaging-franking:v1' || 0x00 || conversationId || clientMessageId || senderPrincipalId (16 bytes each) || plaintext UTF-8)). The client draws a fresh 32-byte frankingKey per message and carries it INSIDE the MLS plaintext; recipients check the commitment after decryption. MANAGED sends refuse it (FRANKING_E2EE_ONLY).

poll.description: 1.36.0, MANAGED only: this message is a poll (text is its question; no attachments; not an announcement). The message's managed.presentation is POLL.

SendMessageRequest.description: Which fields apply is decided by the conversation's PERSISTED security profile: PRIVATE_E2EE needs deviceId, epoch and ciphertext and refuses text (CONTENT_REJECTED / PLAINTEXT_IN_E2EE); MANAGED needs text and refuses ciphertext.

frankingCommitment.description: S2: the sender's franking commitment (HMAC-SHA256, see SendMessageRequest.frankingCommitment).

e2ee.description: The protected envelope (Appendix H.1): version, protocol, cipher suite and the scope the client bound into the AAD; the server stores and relays the ciphertext without reading it.

poll.description: 1.36.0: present on poll messages (presentation POLL): options, voters and close state; null when it cannot be shown.

securityProvenance.description: NATIVE: created through Messaging. LEGACY_MANAGED: imported from a legacy chat store (MANAGED only, never presented as end-to-end encrypted).

oneOf.description: LEGACY_MANAGED: the original time at the legacy source.

channel.description: IN_APP, or SMS: arrived through the SMS Bridge (MANAGED only; never end-to-end encrypted).

replyToMessageId.description: The message this one replies to (same conversation, within the sender's history window).

threadRootId.description: The root of the reply thread (the first message replied to).

forwarded.description: S11: a server-side forward (the source conversation and message are never disclosed).

forwardedFromPrincipalId.description: S11: the original sender, only when the policy shows it (messages.forwardShowsOriginalSender).

viaApplicationId.description: ADR 0064: the CF Meet App (OAuth client id = application id) whose OAuth access or bot credential sent this message; absent on every other message.

Message.description: A message. Content (ciphertext or MANAGED text) only while ACTIVE. e2ee for PRIVATE_E2EE rows, managed for MANAGED rows; the acceptance digest binds the server sequence and id to the ciphertext (cfmeet-messaging-acceptance:v2).

PermalinkResolution.description: A permalink is never authority: resolution checks current membership; a non-member and an unknown id are the same NOT_FOUND.

text.description: MANAGED plain text (UTF-8, 1-16384 characters, no control characters). No markup subset is defined: the server never interprets HTML, Markdown or scripts, stores the text exactly as given and returns it as a JSON string; clients render it as text (escaping it), never as markup.

expectedEditCount.description: Optimistic version check: the editCount the editor last saw. If another edit committed first the request is refused with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT (reason EDITED_CONCURRENTLY). Omitted: last writer wins.

data.description: camelCase payload; message events carry the message's CURRENT representation (a deleted message replays as a tombstone).

ConversationEvent.description: A durable conversation event (derived from committed state, replayable by its per-conversation eventSequence). Every durable event names its tenant, application and environment (§117).

syncRequired.description: The requested position is older than the retained event window: resynchronize messages by sequence.

groupInfo.description: base64url MLSMessage (wire format mls_group_info) of the epoch this commit creates, signed by the committer, with the ratchet tree and external_pub extensions: PUBLIC material that lets a member's new device join by itself (RFC 9420 section 12.4.3.2). Its group id must be the conversation's and its epoch the commit's epoch + 1.

CommitRequest.description: An MLS Commit created in the group's current epoch. removedDeviceIds is the committer's attestation of the leaves it removes; while removals are pending it must cover them all. An external commit (a PublicMessage whose sender is new_member_commit, RFC 9420 section 12.4.3.2) is a member's own ACTIVE device joining by itself: accepted only from the acting principal's own device, without welcome or removedDeviceIds, and not while a removal of a device still in the tree is pending; every member's client verifies the joining leaf against the device directory before merging it.

groupInfo.description: base64url GroupInfo of the CURRENT epoch (as its committer published it), or null when none was published for this epoch. A member's device that is not in the tree joins from it by an external commit.

groupInfoEpoch.description: The epoch of groupInfo (always mlsEpoch when present).

deviceIds.description: Only these devices of the listed principals: a member adding a principal's NEW device leaves the KeyPackages of the devices already in the tree untouched.

accountSessionRef.description: First-party relays only (others: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE). The relay's opaque reference of the VERIFIED account session the token is issued for; ending that account session (POST /v1/messaging/session-devices/revoke) ends this client session too, and no other.

ClientToken.description: A short-lived Messaging Client Access Token (compact JWS, EdDSA, typ cfmeet-mcat+jwt) bound to tenant, application, environment, principal, device and session. Device-direct use only: POST /v1/realtime/tickets.

RealtimeTicket.description: Single-use, seconds-long WebSocket ticket, presented as a Sec-WebSocket-Protocol entry (never in the URL).

shareReadReceipts.description: Appendix K: whether this principal's read position is shared with other members (its own sessions always follow it).

pushDeliveryConfigured.description: false: no push adapter / credentials for this platform in this deployment; jobs end NOT_CONFIGURED (never reported delivered).

size.description: Exact byte size of the stored object (ciphertext for PRIVATE_E2EE).

mediaType.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: always application/octet-stream (the real type is protected inside MLS).

oneOf.description: MANAGED only: sanitized presentation name (never a storage key).
MANAGED only, client-declared presentation metadata (durations are NOT verified by the server).

scan.description: PRIVATE_E2EE attachments are ciphertext: never scanned and never reported as scanned (NOT_APPLICABLE_ENCRYPTED).

derivatives.description: Server-made derivatives (metadata reads only; empty for PRIVATE_E2EE).

Attachment.description: An attachment's authorized metadata and lifecycle. Bytes live in protected object storage under a server-generated key.

size.description: Exact byte size of the stored object (ciphertext for PRIVATE_E2EE).

mediaType.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: always application/octet-stream (the real type is protected inside MLS).

oneOf.description: MANAGED only: sanitized presentation name (never a storage key).
MANAGED only, client-declared presentation metadata (durations are NOT verified by the server).

scan.description: PRIVATE_E2EE attachments are ciphertext: never scanned and never reported as scanned (NOT_APPLICABLE_ENCRYPTED).

upload.description: A signed single-object upload bound to the exact size (content-length), SHA-256 (x-amz-checksum-sha256) and content type: the store rejects any other bytes. Send exactly these headers.

mediaType.description: MANAGED: required, in the kind's allow-list. PRIVATE_E2EE: omit (or application/octet-stream).

deviceId.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the uploading device (the acting principal's).

residualAccessSeconds.description: A grant issued before a revocation stays usable at most this long; GET .../content re-checks authorization on every request.

AttachmentDownloadGrant.description: A short-lived signed read of one object forcing Content-Disposition: attachment and the stored content type. Issued only after authorization (current membership, history window, message ACTIVE, attachment READY).

LegalHold.description: A legal / compliance hold: held items are never purged or deleted. For PRIVATE_E2EE it preserves ciphertext and metadata only; it never creates a decryption capability.

SearchResults.description: Server search covers MANAGED conversations only; PRIVATE_E2EE conversations are searched on devices (LOCAL_SEARCH_ONLY).

frankingKey.description: S2: the message's franking key the reporter's device decrypted (unpadded base64url, 32 bytes); with it the disclosure is verified against the sender's commitment.

disclosure.description: PRIVATE_E2EE only and optional: what the reporter's own device decrypted, disclosed voluntarily (sealed at rest). Unverifiable unless the message was franked and the disclosure carries its frankingKey (S2).

ReportReceipt.description: What the reporter learns: that the report was received. The reported principal is never told who reported.

ReportDetail.description: A report with its evidence (moderation.manage; audited as REPORT_VIEWED).

moderatorPrincipalId.description: G6: the organization moderator (their principal in the organization's scope) an organization moderation request was relayed for; null for an application moderator credential.

ModerationAction.description: Append-only; audited. No action reads PRIVATE_E2EE content.

DeletionRequest.description: Legal holds win: held items are preserved and counted (PARTIALLY_HELD).

SyncResult.description: applied=false: the update is stale or a replay (source version at or below the last applied one) and changed nothing.

items.description: The canonical Messaging message of every imported or already-imported legacy message (the legacy system's stable id mapping).

MeetingMessageModeration.description: Removal of a meeting-conversation message by the meeting authority (which already compared the host's role with the sender's). Idempotent.

ContextAuthorityUpdate.description: Part V H §103: the current authority of a peer-owned communication context (opaque reference only; never a telephone number or contact value). Version-fenced; REVOKED / SUSPENDED apply even to a suspended tenant, ACTIVE needs full authority.

SmsBridgeDisclosure.description: Part V H §106: the disclosure a bridge creator must acknowledge (version-pinned).

CreateSmsBridgeRequest.description: Bridge a MANAGED conversation to one external party by SMS. The number is passed to the SMS Gateway once and never stored by Messaging. A PRIVATE_E2EE conversation is never bridged (E2EE_CONVERSATION_NOT_BRIDGEABLE).

SmsTransport.description: Carrier state of one bridged message — separate from in-app delivery and read state (§110).

InboundSms.description: An inbound SMS of a bridged party (SMS Gateway → Messaging, messaging-sms-bridge.deliver).

pricing.description: Messaging records usage facts only; it never prices or bills.

UsageSummary.description: Usage facts of the caller's application environment (Part V I §129): quantities only, no price, rate or cost.

cosignedAtMicros.description: When the witness cosigned (Unix microseconds); signed.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the length-prefixed encoding of label 'cfmeet-messaging-kt-witness-cosignature:v1', witnessId, logId, treeSize (u64 BE), rootHash, timestampMicros (i64 BE) and cosignedAtMicros (i64 BE) — packages/messaging-crypto transparency::witness_cosignature_input.

WitnessCosignature.description: One witness's cosignature of a tree head.

transferPublicKey.description: base64url X25519 HPKE public key (32 bytes) generated by the TARGET device for this transfer only.

expiresAt.description: At most one hour from now (whole seconds are signed).

requestSignature.description: Ed25519 signature by the TARGET device key over packages/messaging-crypto history_transfer::request_signing_input.

HistoryTransferRequest.description: A new device's request for the history its existing device holds (ADR 0052 AD-07).

HistoryTransfer.description: A device-to-device history transfer. Messaging relays an opaque sealed history between two ACTIVE devices of one principal; it holds no key that opens it (no recovery key, no escrow) and deletes the sealed bytes on completion, cancellation, revocation or expiry.

sealedHistory.description: base64url of the sealed history: HPKE (RFC 9180) ciphertext to the transfer key, signed by the SOURCE device (history_transfer::seal_history).

status.description: QUOTA_DEFERRED: the environment's storage budget has no room for the thumbnail. No object is stored or charged; the original attachment is unaffected; the derivative is retried later or when the attachment policy changes (errorCode STORAGE_BUDGET).

size.description: The stored object's actual bytes (THUMBNAIL), charged to the environment's storage budget alongside the original.

metadata.description: INSPECTION only: the measured facts (null for THUMBNAIL and until READY).

AttachmentDerivative.description: A server-made derivative of a MANAGED attachment: a re-encoded PNG thumbnail of an image without the original's metadata (THUMBNAIL), or the measured container, duration and dimensions of an image, voice note or video (INSPECTION, no object). Never produced for PRIVATE_E2EE attachments, whose thumbnails the sending client encrypts itself.

ThumbnailGrant.description: A short-lived read of a MANAGED image's thumbnail, authorized exactly like a download grant of the original.

durationMs.description: Measured from the bytes (null: the container records none).

durationMatchesDeclared.description: Declared vs measured within max(1 s, 5 %); null when either is absent.

MediaInspection.description: What the server measured in a READY MANAGED attachment's bytes (never inferred for PRIVATE_E2EE ciphertext).

MessageRevisionPage.description: The kept prior versions of a MANAGED message, oldest first (revision n = the text after n edits). Visible to members only when editing.revisionHistoryVisible; empty for a deleted message.

BackupIntentRequest.description: An upload intent for one client-encrypted backup object (Appendix I.3). The client encrypts with the shared crypto core under a root key only the user holds; the server never receives a key or content.

upload.description: A signed single-object upload bound to the exact size (content-length), SHA-256 (x-amz-checksum-sha256) and content type: the store rejects any other bytes. Send exactly these headers.

Backup.description: Metadata of an opaque backup object. keyId and clientBackupId come from the object's public header; the server cannot decrypt the object.

expiresAt.description: §49: optional pin expiry (in the future). An expired pin is no longer listed nor counted toward the limit; pinning again renews it.

PinRequest.description: Optional body of PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/pins/{messageId}; an empty body pins without expiry.

unreadReplyCount.description: Replies from others after the caller's read cursor.

ThreadSummary.description: §47: a thread's reply count, last reply and the caller's unread replies, counted only inside the caller's history window (active, not hidden).

InvitationList.description: The acting principal's open (unexpired) invitations to ACTIVE conversations, newest first.

ConversationInbox.description: Section 13 (MSG-007): the inbox summary of a conversation for the acting member, present in GET /v1/conversations answers that have an acting principal. Left conversations are not listed (only ACTIVE memberships are); a tombstoned last message carries its lifecycle and no content.

lastActivityAt.description: The latest application message (or the creation time); the key of orderBy=lastActivity.

unreadCount.description: Active application messages from others after the member's read cursor, inside its history window, not hidden for it.

mentionCount.description: Unread messages that mention the member (the sender's declared mention ids: MANAGED and — B3, 1.34.0 — PRIVATE_E2EE, whose mention text stays inside the ciphertext).

archived.description: F1 (1.34.0): the member archived this chat for itself (PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/inbox-settings). It stays archived when new messages arrive. Never visible to other members.

pinned.description: F1 (1.34.0): the member pinned this chat for itself (at most three; clients list pinned chats first, most recently pinned first).

pinnedAt.description: F1 (1.34.0): when the member pinned this chat (the pin order); null when not pinned.

favourite.description: 1.36.0: the member marked this chat as a favourite for itself (PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/inbox-settings; WhatsApp Favourites). Independent of archive and pin; never visible to other members.

ConversationLastMessage.description: Preview metadata of the last application message visible to the member (its history window and delete-for-me markers honoured).

previewText.description: MANAGED and ACTIVE only: the first 140 characters of the text. Always null for PRIVATE_E2EE (the server holds no plaintext and never returns ciphertext here) and for tombstones.

presentation.description: 1.36.0, MANAGED and ACTIVE only: the message's presentation (a poll previews its question).

attachmentKind.description: 1.36.0, MANAGED and ACTIVE only: the kind of the message's first attachment (e.g. IMAGE, VIDEO, VOICE_NOTE, DOCUMENT), for the chat list's icon.

SessionDeviceTokenRequest.description: Section 13 (ADR 0049 amendment A1). Sent only by a first-party relay acting for a VERIFIED account session; a client never supplies the binding.

accountSessionRef.description: The relay's opaque, domain-separated SHA-256 reference of the account session (Messaging matches it, never reverses it).

notAfter.description: No token outlives this instant (the account access token's own expiry).

sessionDeviceId.description: Renew a token of this ACTIVE session device of the same account session (an open connection then continues with auth.refresh).

SessionDeviceToken.description: A realtime-only client token bound to a session device: POST /v1/realtime/tickets and the WebSocket accept it; every device-direct REST operation refuses it (CLIENT_TOKENS_NOT_ENABLED / SESSION_DEVICE_REALTIME_ONLY); the gateway refuses PRIVATE_E2EE subscriptions (E2EE_DEVICE_REQUIRED). A session device is never an end-to-end encrypted device.

deviceId.description: The session device id (never a registered MLS device).

PushConfiguration.description: 1.25.0: the push platforms THIS deployment delivers to, and the Web Push application-server (VAPID) public key a browser passes to pushManager.subscribe. Nothing secret and nothing per user; payloads are always metadata only (conversation id and sequences; never content, ciphertext, keys or sender).

applicationServerKey.description: base64url (no padding) uncompressed P-256 point (65 bytes).

webPush.description: null while Web Push is not configured.

InviteLink.description: S12: a group join link (never its token).

InviteLinkCreated.description: S12: a new join link with its token, returned only here (stored as SHA-256).

TeamChannelSnapshot.description: G7: an organization team's ACTIVE members (principals in the organization's scope).

ownerPrincipalId.description: Channel owner when this snapshot creates it.

title.description: Display title when this snapshot creates the channel.

sourceVersion.description: Monotonic snapshot version; at or below the applied one changes nothing.

UserSessionRequest.description: ADR 0062: the body of POST /v1/messaging/user-sessions (Authorization: Bearer cfut_...).

installationId.description: Stable per app installation, generated by the SDK.

sessionDeviceId.description: Renew this ACTIVE partner session device of the same principal and installation (NOT_FOUND otherwise).

UserSession.description: ADR 0062: a MANAGED-only partner session device and a short-lived client token bound to it (scopes: the user token's effective msg grants; read -> messages.read / attachments.read, send -> messages.send / attachments.write). Present it as `Authorization: CF-Client-Token <clientToken>` to POST /v1/realtime/tickets and to the partner REST allowlist; renew through this exchange.

UserPushRegistrationRequest.description: ADR 0063: a partner device's push handle (an APNs / APNs VoIP device token or an FCM registration token). Synchronised to the Notification Service; Messaging never stores, echoes or logs it.

UserPushRegistration.description: ADR 0063: a partner push registration as the Notification Service accepted it (never the handle).

installationId.description: Stable per app installation, generated by the SDK.

archived.description: Archive (true) or unarchive (false) the chat for the acting member. Archiving un-pins it.

pinned.description: Pin (true) or unpin (false) the chat for the acting member. Pinning un-archives it; a fourth pin is 409 CONFLICT / PIN_LIMIT_REACHED.

favourite.description: 1.36.0: add (true) or remove (false) the chat from the acting member's Favourites. Independent of archive and pin.

ConversationInboxSettingsRequest.description: F1 (1.34.0): the acting member's own chat-list settings of one conversation. archived and pinned are not both true. 1.36.0: favourite.

favourite.description: 1.36.0: the chat is one of the member's Favourites.

ConversationInboxSettings.description: F1 (1.34.0): the acting member's chat-list settings of one conversation after the change (the same fields as its inbox summary).

options.description: 2-12 answers, distinct (case-insensitively) after trimming, 1-100 characters each.

PollRequest.description: 1.36.0: a MANAGED poll (the message text, 1-300 characters, is its question). PRIVATE_E2EE polls are encrypted application messages (POLL_MANAGED_ONLY).

voterPrincipalIds.description: Who chose this option (members see voters, like WhatsApp).

voterCount.description: Distinct members with a current vote.

Poll.description: 1.36.0: the options and current tally of an ACTIVE MANAGED poll message (Message.managed.poll).

optionIndexes.description: The member's choices; they replace its previous vote. Empty retracts it. At most one unless the poll allowsMultipleAnswers.

changed.description: false: nothing changed (the same vote again, or an already closed poll).

position.description: The list's place in the member's own order (0 first).

conversationIds.description: Conversations of the list the member is still an ACTIVE member of, in the order they were added.

ChatList.description: 1.36.0: one of the acting member's own chat lists (WhatsApp custom lists). Never visible to anyone else.

name.description: Trimmed; unique (case-insensitively) among the member's lists (409 CONFLICT / CHAT_LIST_NAME_TAKEN).

conversationIds.description: Conversations to start with (each one the member is an ACTIVE member of, else 404).

position.description: Move the list to this place (beyond the end: last); the other lists keep their relative order.

storedParts.description: Owner only: the parts the store holds (resume an upload).

SocialMedia.description: A status / channel photo, video or voice note (bytes in protected object storage, one object per part).

sizeBytes.description: IMAGE / AUDIO at most 8 MiB, VIDEO at most 64 MiB.

SocialMediaPartUpload.description: A signed single-object upload of one part (null `upload` when the part is already stored with this digest).

SocialMediaDownloadGrants.description: Short-lived signed reads of every part, minted only after the reader passed the status / channel gate.

Status.description: A status as the caller sees it. viewCount, shareCount, mentions and audience are present for the author only.

description.description: At most 500 characters; an empty string clears it.
